title: Swap an empty kanban tote for the full one
instruction: The grey tote in the pick slot is empty. Put its yellow kanban card in the white card post, put the empty tote on the black return mat, then move the full blue tote forward into the pick slot between the rails.
context: In a two-bin kanban, the operator works from the front tote; when it runs empty, its card is posted to trigger a refill, the empty tote goes back to the store and the full reserve tote moves forward so the line never starves. The three steps must happen in that order: the full tote cannot move forward until the empty one has left the slot. Unlike TK-G6MY9Q (put new stock behind older stock in a shelf lane), this is the two-bin pull signal: card posted, empty tote returned, reserve tote advanced, in a forced order. Done by: material handlers and production workers (O*NET 53-7062.00, 51-9198.00).
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), everything square to the table. Lane: two fixed steel guide rails (23 x 0.6 x 1 cm) along x, centred at x 24.5 and y 36.1 and 23.9. Totes: closed plastic parts totes 7.5 cm deep (x), 11 cm wide (y), 6 cm tall. Empty tote: grey, 120 g, standing in the pick slot at x 19, y 30. Full tote: blue, 450 g, standing in the reserve slot at x 30, y 30. Kanban card: a yellow plastic card sleeve 5 x 3.5 x 0.6 cm, 10 g, lying flat on the empty tote's lid, centred. Card post: a fixed white open frame, walls 0.6 cm thick and 3 cm tall round a 7 x 5 cm pocket (table floor), centred at x 19, y 15. Return mat: a fixed black mat 12 x 14 cm, 2 mm thick, centred at x 30, y 44.
scoring: From a top photo and a ruler, with the grippers open. 1/3 each: the card is at rest inside the post's inner walls, below their top; the empty tote stands upright (tilt under 8 degrees) on the return mat with its whole footprint on the mat; the full tote stands upright on the table in the pick slot, centre within 1 cm of the slot centre (x 19) along the lane and 6 mm across it, square to the lane within 8 degrees. Possible scores: 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1.0. Success: all three, held 1 s.
reset_notes: Put the grey tote back in the pick slot with the card on its lid and the blue tote in the reserve slot.
fidelity: Rigid boxes with one shared friction (1.2 static, 1.0 dynamic). The totes are closed boxes whose contents are represented by mass only (the full tote is 450 g), and the lane is a flat table with guide rails rather than an inclined gravity flow rack, so the full tote is carried forward instead of rolling. The card post is an open frame rather than a slotted box.
